facts.text: I am looking for advice on crafting a solid pitch for potential investors.
I have been attending a lot of networking events lately.
I met Sarah from Google at the Tech Expo conference last Thursday.
Sarah from Google and I discussed potential collaboration opportunities for my startup at the Tech Expo conference.
I want to make sure I am prepared when I follow up with Sarah and others.
I am reaching out to someone like Sarah from Google who already knows a bit about my startup.
I think I will go with the first example that was provided to me.
I want feedback on my pitch deck.
I have a draft pitch deck.
I am not sure if I am including too much information in my pitch deck.
I am not sure if my pitch deck is clear and concise enough.
I am ready to review the pitch deck and asked the assistant to share it with me.
I will describe my pitch deck to the assistant and ask for feedback.
My pitch deck is for my startup.
My startup is a platform that helps small businesses manage their online presence.
The first slide of my pitch deck is a title slide with our company name, logo, and tagline.
The second slide of my pitch deck is a problem statement slide describing the challenges small businesses face in managing their online presence.
The third slide of my pitch deck describes our solution.
Our solution is a platform that allows small businesses to manage their website, social media, and online reviews in one place.
The fourth slide of my pitch deck highlights the market opportunity.
The fourth slide includes the number of small businesses in the US and the growing importance of online presence.
The fifth slide of my pitch deck describes our competitive landscape.
The fifth slide includes other companies that offer similar solutions.
The sixth slide of my pitch deck talks about our traction.
The sixth slide includes the number of beta testers we've signed up.
The sixth slide includes positive feedback we've received.
The seventh slide of my pitch deck outlines our business model.
Our business model is subscription-based.
The eighth slide of my pitch deck introduces our team, including our founders.
